profile_text.body:
Datadog, Inc. describes itself as cloud monitoring as a service, offering a way to see metrics from all of a customer's apps, tools and services in one place, with a free trial. The company also markets security alongside observability, saying that integrating the two lets organizations decode runtime execution, eliminate exposure in dynamic AI environments, and carry out detection and response at what it calls agentic speed to keep ahead of AI-powered attacks.

The company is a for-profit public company with headquarters in New York, NY, traded under the ticker DDOG, and identified by CIK 0001561550. It is also listed under the alias DATADOG INC - CLASS A.

No products or MCP servers are listed for Datadog, and no individual lawsuits are recorded. Its law exposure is recorded in New York, with a count of 458.
